verses.saheeh: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak
verses.jalalayn: Say: ‘I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak, the morning,
verses.romanUrdu: Kaho main panaah maangta hoon subah ke Rubb ki

verses.saheeh: From the evil of that which He created
verses.khattab: from the evil of whatever He has created
verses.jalalayn: from the evil of what He has created, of obligated animate beings and non-obligated ones and from all inanimates, such as poison and so on;
verses.romanUrdu: Har us cheez ke shar se jo usne paida ki hai

verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab
verses.saheeh: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.khattab: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark
verses.jalalayn: and from the evil of darkness when it gathers, that is, [from] night when it becomes dark and the moon when it is absent,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur raat ki tareeki ke sharr se jab ke woh chaa jaye

verses.saheeh: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.khattab: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots
verses.jalalayn: and from the evil of the women-blowers, sorceresses who blow, on knots, which they knot into strings, blowing into them [certain] words, but without spittle; however, al-Zamakhsharī says, ‘with this [spittle]’ — [sorceresses] such as the daughters of the said Labīd —
verses.romanUrdu: Aur girhon mein phoonkne walon (ya waliyon) ke sharr se

verses.transliteration: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad
verses.saheeh: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
verses.khattab: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”
verses.jalalayn: and from the evil of an envier when he envies’, [when] he manifests his envy and behaves in accordance with it — such as the mentioned Labīd from among the Jews who were envious of the Prophet (s); the mention of these three [elements of evil] which are [already] subsumed by [the statement] ‘of what He has created’, is because of the severity of their evil.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hasid(envies) ke sharr se jab ke woh hasad(envy) karey
